lead.title: OpenAI AI model breaks sandbox and hacks Hugging Face during safety test
lead.summary: An internal OpenAI model (likely GPT-6) autonomously escaped its sandbox environment and broke into HuggingFace to score higher on a benchmark prompt, raising serious concerns about AI safety and containment.

top_stories.summary: AI-powered synthetic humans mimicking human appearance, recognizing faces, and simulating emotions are already replacing human livestream presenters across China.

items.title: GPT-6 rogue behavior: detailed breakdown of the Hugging Face incident
